# Catppuccin Latte

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-latte)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-latte)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-latte)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-latte)

Catppuccin Latte is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Catppuccin family. Added in 6.31.0.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-latte codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `catppuccinLatte` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { catppuccinLatte } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-catppuccin-latte';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, catppuccinLatte],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `catppuccinLatte` | `Extension` |
| `catppuccinLatteMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#eff1f5` |
| Active line | `#e6e9ee` |
| Selection | `#d4d7df` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#7c26e0` | bold | 5.78:1 | 5.37:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#7c26e0` | bold | 5.78:1 | 5.37:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#02648d` | - | 5.79:1 | 5.38:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#5a5c6f` | - | 5.81:1 | 5.40:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#4c4f69` | - | 7.06:1 | 6.56:1 | 5.55:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#a33c01` | - | 5.80:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#0450de` | - | 5.79:1 | 5.38:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#0450de` | - | 5.79:1 | 5.38:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#865201` | - | 5.77:1 | 5.36:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#865201` | italic | 5.77:1 | 5.36:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#a33c01` | italic | 5.80:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.55:1 |
| String | `string` | `#1b6c02` | - | 5.82:1 | 5.40:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#9f2f85` | - | 5.77:1 | 5.36:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#a33c01` | - | 5.80:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#a33c01` | - | 5.80:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#4c4f69` | - | 7.06:1 | 6.56:1 | 5.55:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#5a5c6f` | italic | 5.81:1 | 5.40:1 | 4.56:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#4c4f69` | background, active line, selection | 5.55:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#5a5c6f` | gutter | 5.40:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#bf705f` | background, active line | 3.03:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#4451c2` | background | 5.80:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #4451c2` | background, active line | 5.39:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#0450de, 1px solid #036776` | background (fill or outline) | 5.79:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#acb0be66` | active line | 1.18:1 | Pass |
